YOUR PATH TO TEST DAY

Stop guessing what to study next.

A great prep experience should turn every test session into the next useful action.

Diagnose

2

Prioritize

3

Practice

Use targeted drills with explanations, strategy, and mistake review.

4

Simulate

Switch into timed mode to build pacing, endurance, and navigation habits.

5

Review

Rework missed questions and watch accuracy improve over repeat sessions.

TRUST & TRANSPARENCY

Professional prep should never pretend to be “official.”

TSI Practice Prep separates official test-format facts from independently created practice questions. No fabricated student counts, no fake score guarantees, and no claim that original practice items are previously administered official questions.

Original practice contentSkill-aligned questions written for practice.
Visible disclaimersIndependent platform status is clearly stated.
Format-aware updatesTSIA2, SAT, and ACT structure can be reviewed against primary sources.
Correction-friendlyEditorial standards make quality issues easier to identify and fix.

Accuracy Standards →Editorial Standards →Official Resources →Privacy →Independent Disclaimer →
Question integrity

Correct questions need a quality gate.

Before a question belongs in serious practice, its answer index, choices, explanation, distractor analysis, skill label, and strategy must all be complete.

Question Bank Integrity Monitor

This automated check catches missing explanations, invalid answer keys, duplicate answer choices, incomplete distractor reasoning, and duplicate IDs. It does not replace human academic review, so TSI Practice Prep keeps a correction/report pathway as well.

ACT Writing Lab

Practice developing a clear position on a complex issue, considering multiple perspectives, organizing reasoning, and revising your writing. This is independent practice, not an official ACT Writing score.

0 wordsDraft saves in this browser.
Ideas & AnalysisDevelop a clear position and engage meaningfully with the issue and perspectives.
Development & SupportExplain reasoning with relevant examples and sufficient detail.
OrganizationUse purposeful sequencing, paragraphing, and transitions.
Language Use & ConventionsUse clear, controlled sentences and standard written English.
Practice Estimate: —Computed from real, measurable signals in what you wrote below, mapped onto ACT Writing's actual 4-domain, 2–12 reporting scale (Ideas & Analysis, Development & Support, Organization, Language Use & Conventions). It is not an official, human-scored ACT Writing score, is always reported separately from your ACT Composite (which never includes Writing), and does not evaluate true grammar correctness or the truth of your reasoning.
Important: ACT Writing is optional in the current enhanced ACT structure and is reported separately — it is not part of the ACT Composite score. This lab is only for students who choose or need to practice the optional writing component.

TSI Essay Lab

Use this lab to practice planning, drafting, revising, and self-checking an academic position essay. Feedback here is for learning and is not an official TSIA2 essay score.

0 wordsDraft saves in this browser.
Purpose & FocusIs the thesis clear, specific, and maintained throughout the essay?
Organization & StructureDo ideas follow a logical sequence, with paragraphing and effective transitions?
Development & SupportAre reasons explained with specific examples, details, or logical support?
Sentence Variety & StyleAre sentences clear and varied rather than repetitive in length and structure?
Mechanical ConventionsGrammar, usage, punctuation, and other surface-level writing conventions.
Critical ThinkingDoes the essay engage with a counterargument or alternate viewpoint?
Practice Estimate: —Computed from real, measurable signals in what you wrote below, mapped onto TSIA2's actual 1–8 Essay scale and its six real writing dimensions (purpose & focus, organization & structure, development & support, sentence variety & style, mechanical conventions, critical thinking). It is not an official, human- or engine-scored TSIA2 essay score, and does not evaluate true grammar correctness or the truth of your reasoning.
Revision goal: after completing the first draft, revise at least one paragraph for stronger evidence and one sentence for clearer structure. Practice improvement comes from revision, not only from writing more drafts.

Blueprint-Aligned Question Integrity

Every active practice item is limited to skills that belong to the current TSIA2, SAT, or Enhanced ACT blueprint. TSI Practice Prep uses independently written practice—not recalled, leaked, copied, or lightly rewritten live-test questions.

🎓 Digital SATReading & Writing: Information and Ideas, Craft and Structure, Expression of Ideas, Standard English Conventions. Math: Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Geometry and Trigonometry.
🎯 Enhanced ACTEnglish, Math, Reading, and optional Science are aligned to current ACT reporting categories, including Production of Writing, Preparing for Higher Math, Key Ideas & Details, and scientific-data reasoning.
📘 TSIA2Math is restricted to Quantitative, Algebraic, Geometric/Spatial, and Probabilistic/Statistical Reasoning. ELAR is restricted to literary/informational analysis plus revision, editing, and sentence conventions.

Accuracy and Content Standards

TSI Practice Prep uses original practice questions written to reflect tested skills. It does not reproduce official test questions unless permission is available, and it does not present practice results as official scores.

✓Original Practice Questions

Questions are independently written for learning and practice, not copied from protected official test banks.

📚Official Structure Sources

Exam structure and test-format information should be checked against College Board, ACT, and relevant state education agencies.

⚠No Score Guarantees

Practice performance is not an official TSI, SAT, or ACT score and does not guarantee admission, placement, or graduation.

🔄Review and Correction

Time-sensitive requirements should be rechecked when official testing organizations or state agencies publish updates.

Quick answers

Is TSI Practice Prep really free?

Yes. Every TSI, SAT, and ACT practice test and skill set on TSI Practice Prep is 100% free, with no sign-up required to start practicing.

Is there a free TSI practice test?

Yes. TSI Practice Prep offers a free TSIA2 practice test covering both Math and ELAR (Reading and Writing), with instant feedback and explanations for every question.

Is there a free SAT practice test?

Yes. TSI Practice Prep's free SAT practice test covers Reading and Writing plus Math, in a format that mirrors the digital SAT, with mistake analysis after every session.

Is there a free ACT practice test?

Yes. TSI Practice Prep's free ACT practice test covers English, Math, Reading, and optional Science, with detailed, skill-by-skill error analysis.

Are these official TSIA2, SAT, or ACT questions?

No. TSI Practice Prep uses independently written practice questions aligned to tested skills.

Is the score estimate official?

No. It is a practice estimate based on this TSI Practice Prep set. Official scores use the testing organization's scoring process.

Does a college match mean I will be admitted?

No. The list only shows schools whose reported score ranges are near your estimate. Admissions consider many other factors.
